Replay Foundry optional local English semantic search

Model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
ONNX INT8 conversion: Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
Pinned conversion revision: 751bff37182d3f1213fa05d7196b954e230abad9
https://huggingface.co/Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
License: Apache License, Version 2.0 (see MiniLM-LICENSE.txt)

The optional model and BERT vocabulary are downloaded from the pinned conversion
revision and verified by SHA-256 before use. Replay Foundry uses CPU inference,
uncased BERT WordPiece tokenization, at most 256 tokens, attention-mask mean
pooling and L2 normalization. Text similarity is retrieval relevance, not proof
that a statement or game event occurred. Negation, hypothetical statements,
sarcasm and languages other than English are not reliably distinguished.

References:
Reimers and Gurevych, Sentence-BERT (2019).
Wang et al., MiniLM: Deep Self-Attention Distillation for Task-Agnostic
Compression of Pre-Trained Transformers (2020).
